title: Describe an Interview Experience
instructions: Read the example aloud for practice, then record your own response with different details.
prompt: Describe a fictional interview you attended. Say why you applied, describe one experience and skill you discussed, explain a question you asked, and say what happened afterwards. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six different lesson words.
reference: Last month I saw a vacancy at a community center and sent an application. I wanted the position because I enjoy helping people find useful information. At the interview, the manager asked about my experience. I described a library event where a colleague and I worked as a team. My example showed that I could listen to a customer and finish a task carefully. I also asked about the wage and the first responsibility in the department. The employer did not give me a decision that day, so I wrote down the date for a reply. After the interview, I planned to resume volunteering and practice another example for my career goal.
